verification.environment: Separate ephemeral Linux/container sandbox. X2/CoStead untouched.

important_caveats: An archive and its internal manifest can both be replaced by an adversary. A separately retained trusted checksum is necessary but not sufficient to prove publisher identity.
The private ZIP does not recover CoAcademy, CoRelay, GitHub Issues, linked official source currentness, accounts or remote publication.
R0 and R3 remain separate preserved historical lineage; success counters and artifacts are not interchangeable.
The sandbox blocks browser URL navigation to localhost. The human-browser URL case is untested rather than falsely passed.
No purported live watcher, automatically evolving bot, magical service continuation or independent durable offsite mirror was created.
next_acceptance: Copy actual ZIP+checksum to a separately administered custodian with verifiable readback and restore authority
Verify a full restore after deliberately disconnecting GitHub and the original source mount
Establish an independently hosted public mirror only after rights, privacy, DNS and independent HTTPS checks
Create an approved second feedback receiver that does not share the GitHub provider failure domain
Perform accessibility and local network browser tests outside this administrator-restricted sandbox
